# Benchmark index

[Home](../../README.md) · [Documentation](../README.md) · [All experiments](../experiments/README.md)

Select a benchmark to read its training setting, evaluation unit, results, and complete task records. Each result belongs to its own policy and protocol; only LIBERO-plus shares a checkpoint with LIBERO.

| Benchmark | Training setting | Evaluation coverage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [RoboTwin 2.0](robotwin/README.md) | Independent policy per backbone; Clean + Randomized data | 50 tasks × 100 episodes × 2 scenes per backbone |
| [LIBERO](libero/README.md) | Independent LIBERO policy; 40k updates | 40 tasks × 50 episodes |
| [LIBERO-plus](liberoplus/README.md) | LIBERO checkpoint; no extra training | 10,030 perturbation variants × 1 episode |
| [RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop](robocasa_tabletop/README.md) | Independent GR1 Tabletop policy; 50k updates | 24 tasks × 50 episodes |
| [CALVIN](calvin/README.md) | Independent ABCD policy; 34k updates | 1,000 continuous five-task chains in D |

CALVIN uses ABCD → D: environment D is included in training. Its successful-prefix metric is reported separately from isolated episode success.
